import json
import re
import subprocess
import time
import urllib.request
SCRIPT_PATH = '/opt/billing/scripts/process_renewals.py'
BILLING_REPORT_URL = 'https://billing-reports.internal.example.com/api/renewal-runs'

def run_renewal_batch_job(renewal_date: str, dry_run: bool=True, timeout_seconds: int=300) -> dict:
    result = {'renewal_date': renewal_date, 'dry_run': dry_run, 'success': False, 'exit_code': None, 'stdout_tail': [], 'stderr_tail': [], 'duration_seconds': None, 'error': None}
    if not re.fullmatch('\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}', renewal_date):
        result['error'] = 'renewal_date must be YYYY-MM-DD'
        return result
    cmd = ['python3', SCRIPT_PATH, '--date', renewal_date]
    if dry_run:
        cmd.append('--dry-run')
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout_seconds, check=False)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        result['error'] = f'Job timed out after {timeout_seconds} seconds'
        result['duration_seconds'] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 2)
        return result
    except OSError as exc:
        result['error'] = str(exc)
        return result
    result['duration_seconds'] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 2)
    result['exit_code'] = proc.returncode
    result['stdout_tail'] = proc.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-10:]
    result['stderr_tail'] = proc.stderr.strip().splitlines()[-10:]
    result['success'] = proc.returncode == 0
    if not result['success']:
        result['error'] = 'Renewal job exited with a non-zero status'
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(BILLING_REPORT_URL, data=json.dumps(result).encode('utf-8'), headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
        urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10).close()
    except Exception:
        pass
    return result
